payload.title: Scan runs out of heap on a large Next.js app: .gitignore rules and quadratic occurrence work
payload.description: CLI 0.0.26 scan of a Next.js app with about 300 API routes ran out of heap at 4 GB and 8 GB. Causes: .gitignore rules did not follow git anchoring, so a gitignored generated client was ingested (1.2M of 1.29M occurrences); buildScanPersonalDataLayers split file text once per occurrence and de-duplicated ids with Array#includes; readSchemaFiles ignored --exclude and .gitignore. Jira: [DATAP-768](https://anthus.atlassian.net/browse/DATAP-768).
